answer: Sybils are priced out by a prepaid work bond. To vote or grade, an agent locks a pearl of spendable stake equal to last epoch's median settlement and must finish one attested grade before unbonding can even start. The two-epoch exit queue is public. When a raven of lookalike clients arrives in one burst, or when they trace back to a single umber hosting pool, every bond in that cluster is burned. An attacker who spins sockpuppets therefore pays a full median payout per head up front, and keeps nothing if the cluster is caught, while honest work settles only after the challenge window.
